description: This file contains Redux action creators and related functions for managing channel categories in Mattermost, including creating, updating, moving, and deleting categories, as well as handling category sorting and muting.

methods.name: setCategoryCollapsed
methods.description: Creates an action to set the collapsed state of a category.

methods.name: setCategorySorting
methods.description: Creates an action to set the sorting method of a category.

methods.name: patchCategory
methods.description: Updates a category with provided patch data and syncs with server.

methods.name: setCategoryMuted
methods.description: Sets the muted state of a category and updates related channels.

methods.name: updateCategory
methods.description: Helper function to update a category on the server.

methods.name: fetchMyCategories
methods.description: Fetches categories for a team for the current user.

methods.name: addChannelToInitialCategory
methods.description: Adds a new or joined channel to appropriate category based on type.

methods.name: addChannelToCategory
methods.description: Adds a channel to a specific category.

methods.name: moveChannelToCategory
methods.description: Moves a channel into a category at a specified position.

methods.name: moveChannelsToCategory
methods.description: Moves multiple channels into a category at a specified position.

methods.name: receivedCategoryOrder
methods.description: Creates an action to set the order of categories for a team.

methods.name: createCategory
methods.description: Creates a new category on the server.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Deletes a category from the server.
